note: No member. A key holder may hold one room as two members, each with its own marker, and the client must apply the one it watches as.
No marker. The document exists to carry it; a bare "something moved" would make every client list the room to find out what.
Which client moved the marker. The recipient has no use for it, and it would tell every watching device which of the member's devices they read on.
A marker carrying when the member read. A marker is where they read to, never when.
